The main danger is relaxing vigilance once order appears established, especially when partial conditions are mistaken for permission to press ahead. Its constructive capacity is care at the threshold where success can unravel, expressed through attention to sequence, relation, and the limits of the present position. Transformation comes through responsive timing: capacity remains available because it is neither suppressed nor spent against the grain.

The result is not certainty about an outcome, but a more differentiated ability to choose, relate, and remain present within changing conditions.
